# A22 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A22′ — The Atlas, Not the Camera](conjugate/A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The atlas is the essay's constructive operation. Historical Objective Internality is a direct developmental carrier, not a second canonical identity for A22.

## #0

A world-atlas makes situated accounts traversable. Each picture remains placed; its overlaps, transformations and obstructions become part of what it says. [[A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency|A04]] grounds contextual transparency; [[A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|A16]] grounds differential placement; [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] shows why a consequential image must remain answerable to its source. Their epistemic consequence changes the relation to picturing itself.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology.md|Heidegger’s world-picture source]] sources a specific historical diagnosis in q012–q014: the modern event is the world grasped as picture together with the representer becoming its normative centre. That paraphrased diagnosis exceeds the simple existence of pictures. Lovitt's wording is verified, while print collation and several page locators remain pending. The atlas does not appear in Heidegger as this essay's constructive technical proposal.

## #1

A picture has a frame before its contents are assembled. The box-lid image gives a jigsaw its finished arrangement in advance; every piece is then judged by the place that arrangement assigns. Inquiry becomes different when travel discloses the frame's own conditions or encounters a piece whose relation cannot be settled by the lid. Collecting more pieces cannot alone correct the criterion of fit.

Q27's stained-glass development supplies the fuller operation. Light, panes, lead cames, aperture, viewer and cast image work together. Each pane transmits, colours and interrupts; the cames preserve seams and non-equivalences. Move the light or viewer and the visible pattern changes through the same constructed window. A source's difference is therefore information for the composition, not an impurity to be removed by averaging. The complete image is a context of transmission, not a pile of decorative fragments.

The T25 paradigmatic field names the general relation already operating here. A world-picture is not only a representation *of* a world; as a consequential determination it is a **Project** thrown forth within a **Paradigm**, a pattern of disclosure which has already helped decide what can appear, count and fit. The atlas becomes reflexive when it can make those paradigmatic conditions themselves comparable—source, gauge, frame, admitted transition, exclusion and situated viewer—rather than treating every picture as if it arrived from nowhere. This is the `/↔1` projection/enactment relation of the [Genesis / Paradigm / Project / Epi-Logos field](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md), consumed here at evidence register 3; it is not a claim that Heidegger or atlas theory supplied the authorial QL relation.

## #2

An atlas requires declared conditions of transition. For local charts with coordinate maps `φᵢ` and `φⱼ`, an overlap permits the transition `φⱼ ∘ φᵢ⁻¹` on the relevant domain. This mathematical operation has explicit hypotheses: the maps must have the required inverse and common region, and the transition must satisfy the structure being studied. A collection of incompatible descriptions does not become a mathematical atlas by being stored together.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the author's distinction between this chart operation and attractor dynamics. A basin organises trajectories; an atlas coordinates partial disclosures. Symbolic movement can illuminate both while leaving their mathematical objects distinct. In the epistemic extension, a transition must state the question, scale, assumptions, preserved distinctions and changed criterion. An obstruction is a result to expose: these accounts cannot yet be composed for this purpose under these conditions. It is not a reason to manufacture agreement.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas|C37 World-Atlas]] defines this reusable demand. Adequacy remains discriminating: some accounts fail their own tests, some address different objects, and some genuinely conflict. The atlas must make those differences intelligible enough to guide a next encounter.

## #3

The corrected Bimba relation prevents the atlas from claiming the place it has denied to its pictures. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] defines Original and reflected determination. Every produced world-picture, including an instrument's reference map and this atlas, is pratibimba. Inside a declared Context Frame it can genuinely occupy Bimba, the local original for downstream readings, while remaining pratibimba in relation to wider sources. This recursively local office has real, revisable authority; it does not make the artifact metaphysically Original. Q27's later explicit correction supersedes its earlier sentence assigning the produced picture to Bimba.

The paradigm/project relation sharpens the same guard. A locally authoritative map can organise what later projects encounter and therefore become causally prior within a subsequent circuit. That efficacy is precisely why its construction must remain recoverable. A projected reference becomes counterfeit sourcehood when the wider source can appear only in categories supplied by the projection itself. Conversely, returned obstruction becomes paradigmatic evidence when it can revise the reference, transition rule or frame that organised the prior view. Atlas-making is thus a practice of keeping **projection consequential without making projection originary**.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses.md|The MEF source house]] sources the internal lens architecture; its older no-local-file statement is stale against the recoverable twelve-lens reference. That reference's L4/L4′ correction gives a precise transformation: each carries the whole rotated Name/Power constellation, with opposite faces grounding the view. Changing lens changes the governing relation rather than deleting the rest of the field. The architecture's historical attributions, musical subset claims and practical utility require separate warrant; its inherited six subheadings do not govern this page.

## #4

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md|Gebser’s source house]] compares perspectival sector and aperspectival co-presence through its page-specific paraphrase map. The essay's `180°→360°` development changes the unit from a selected view to the field of positions and transformations that makes views possible. It does not grant an observer an unconditioned panorama. Frank's direct P5 Gebser carrier makes context a being-with the text and subtext, invested in outcome and care; that authored interpretation is not a quotation from Gebser.

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter whole field]] derives the return through **Region → Name/Countenance → Account**. A placed and counted participant remains a face able to answer the count. The operational homology does not claim a common word-root for name and number. The account gains maturity when encounter can alter its frame, not merely populate the existing categories more completely.

## #5→0


Symbolic change follows trajectories; the atlas follows chart transitions. The historical comparison retains both objects and their distinct warrants; the [language history](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-dialogue) **qualifies** this operational comparison.

The atlas **returns-to** [the developed Bohm dossier](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md) through its running-true comparison. The 18 May 1975 conversation supplies a spinning wheel and straight-running thread; Taylor’s separate mathematical continuation uses multiplication by i to change phase while preserving modulus. A chart passage likewise needs an explicit transformation and a stated preserved relation. The source image cannot certify every transition between epistemic worlds: an obstruction remains part of the account, and the participants’ unresolved formulations remain visible.

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction): The stained-window and holographic movement **figures** an atlas that can revise its own reference. Panes, seams and changing placements disclose different projections under explicit conditions. Within a declared Context Frame an achieved image can genuinely serve as local Bimba, while remaining pratibimba relative to its wider sources. Travel returns evidence capable of revising that local original itself, with no view from nowhere required.

Taylor’s [Necker cube](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube) **figures** a picture whose unchanged lines admit opposed readings, followed by contextual recognition of how those readings arise. The [centre-everywhere image](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere) **extends** the atlas return through real nested internalities: each situated centre opens a world whose relations lead into further centres without acquiring a final exterior circumference. The atlas retains the transitions and the viewer’s place within them. It therefore cannot complete itself by installing a spectator outside all the worlds it makes traversable.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-travel-and-reconstruction) **figures** reconstruction through the same puzzle whose box-lid once predetermined every fit. Travel exposes the framing activity; pieces become local charts with overlaps and declared transitions. The first picture survives as a situated achievement within an atlas the journey can revise.

The [stained-glass whole’s return](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-return) **figures** a changed reader returning through source, pane, seam and exclusion. The map can genuinely occupy Bimba as a local original within a declared Context Frame while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. That recursive office gives reference real authority and allows the returned encounter to revise the local reference itself.

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Account does not replace source](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-does-not-replace-source) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. A chart carries its conditions and the limits of transition to another chart. Returned obstruction can change the comparison rather than be hidden by accumulating more pictures. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

The atlas also **returns-to** [Paradigm-through-Project → Projection / Enactment](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md#1--paradigm-through-project-projection--enactment) at evidence register 3. A chart or Bimba can become a real condition of later action; the atlas remains healthy where its projected determinations expose the paradigm that made them legible and where encountered resistance can revise that mediation. The project thereby returns through its paradigm without either being discarded as unreal or promoted into the source it represents.

The circumference remains a valid view while the atlas exposes the body, opening and other conditions omitted when that view claims the whole. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-position-opposition).

The invariant remains `world ≠ world-model`. A model's rich representations and a federation's many models do not exhaust the world in which they were learned and into which their actions return. [[A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|A26]] grounds the active objective internality which precedes representational technique. A disclosed harness records some conditions of an event; it does not contain all the material, institutional and interpersonal relations that made the event possible.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md|Agentworld]] compares divergent worlds sharing a grammar of interaction. Common grammar permits disagreement to acquire shape; it does not make different ontologies identical. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] tests whether that disagreement can revise the governing view; [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether the revision changes actual operation. Their consequence returns to the atlas as a changed route, sharper obstruction or newly situated account.

**Depth Restoration:** world-as-picture/source diagnosis, box-lid and whole stained-glass operations, chart transition and obstruction, attractor/atlas distinction, corrected Bimba stack, L4/L4′ full-field lens correction, answerable encounter, and paradigm/project projection return restored from the A22 packet and direct Objective Internality, Symbolon Dynamics, MEF, P5 Gebser, Q27 and T25 paradigmatic carriers. **Remaining debt:** selected-edition Heidegger/Gebser collation, full historical perspectivism and concrete cartographic/technical exemplars. P1 consumers M05/M41 remain in their own Movement homes; no universal panorama or automatic synthesis is claimed.
